text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When passing near the hollow of the giant 
tree……

Nwaaaaahhh!! I just wanna blast off into 
outer spaaace!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ——Eek!? S-Someone heard me?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
N-No, well…… isn't this the spot where 
you're supposed to scream your feelings 
into a tree hollow?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
I just…… happened to remember that race 
the other day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAAAH……!!)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Eheheh♪ In top form even for a mock race! 
The great Tokai Teio takes 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
……I was definitely in peak condition 
today. And yet, to Teio again……!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Dammit…… dammit all……!! It's so 
unbelievably frustrating……!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
……So that's what happened. Well, part of 
it was just venting my frustration, but……

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
More than that, a background character 
like me getting all caught up in some 
youthful drama just felt totally 
embarrassing. Ahahaha……

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Aha~n? I thought Helios was screaming 
again, but it was just you, Nature?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Could it be you're still hung up on losing 
to Teio the other day?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Palmer-san…… Ugh…… no comment.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Come on, now. I totally get how you feel. 
But moping around won't clear your head— 
how about making a getaway from your timid 
self right now!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh……?! B-By that, you don't mean going at 
it head-on with everything I've got, do 
you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, nothing like that! More like making 
an escape from 'the everyday' into 'the 
extraordinary'.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Just blast off with a super-positive 
breakaway into a world where you're 
completely unrivaled!! After all, 
imagining things is totally free, right?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
……Even if you tell me that, I can't 
picture anything like that at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though Nice Nature felt bewildered and 
thought she couldn't do it, with Mejiro 
Palmer's encouragement, she managed to 
expand her imagination——

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
——'S-Standing on a dazzling stage after a 
sweep of epic, overwhelming victories, 
it's Lady Nature!'

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
'Far from being a Bronze Collector—— I 
shall henceforth be known as the Gold 
Collector!'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah! That's awesome, awesome! Now 
that's a scale worthy of an explosive 
runaway, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
——Gaaah!! N-No, scratch that!! Acting all 
cocky like that doesn't suit me at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, don't get all embarrassed now! If 
anything else comes up, you can always 
talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
When things get rough, just escape like 
that and take it one day at a time♪

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Jeez…… Palmer-san. Life doesn't work out 
that easily, you know.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Though…… well, whatever. I might as well 
play along and try something or other.
